description: A Java class extending Fragment that provides a UI component (LogFragment) containing a custom LogView inside a ScrollView. It initializes views, manages layout and styling, and updates scroll position on text change.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that creates and manages a view containing a LogView and handles layout, styling, and scrolling behavior.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and sets up the ScrollView and LogView, applies styling, and returns the root view.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Overrides Fragment's method to inflate views and adds a TextWatcher to keep the scroll at the bottom when the log updates.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance contained within this fragment.
